description: impl plan 1.4 candidate-mutation contract + 2.26.1: a user content edit creates a new plan_origin=user_edit lineage, is snapped to safe boundaries, and passes the same Layer 1 / Layer 2 pipeline as a model plan. REPAIRABLE and HARD_FAIL are BOTH terminal for a user edit (2.26.1: 'User edits are never automatically Stage-R repaired'): the candidate enters BLOCKED_USER_EDIT, no repaired descendant is created, and the last accepted plan remains intact -- unlike a model plan, which Stage R would attempt to repair.

variants.note: a model-authored plan with the same issue would go through Stage R; this same verdict is terminal for a user edit.

1830ms deliberately does not land on a sentence boundary; the server must snap to the nearest legal sentence-safe boundary (speech-led) rather than inventing a raw timestamp cut. Included as a non-rejection variant for contrast with the two above.
variants.expected_terminal_state: not necessarily BLOCKED_USER_EDIT -- depends on whether the snapped result still passes Layer 1/2
